simple.meaning: קֹדֶשׁ (qôdesh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 467 times across Exodus, Leviticus, beginning at Exodus 3:5. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֹדֶשׁ (H6944).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קֹדֶשׁ (qôdesh) / H6944 is traced through Exodus 3:5, Exodus 12:16, Exodus 15:11, Exodus 15:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.
